integrity: The complete proof and the standalone rational-arithmetic checker are bundled; finite checker assertions are not a proof for arbitrary network size.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two synchronous updates, initially all occupied, homogeneous independent extinction/recolonization, loop-free one-in/one-out directed graph. Does not assert long-horizon survival, heterogeneous applicability or inference from finite noisy observations. Historical priority is provisional because one relevant later full text was not accessible.
title: Directed-cycle partitions determine and extremize two-step metapopulation extinction
